web.archive.org.note: Wayback SPN rate-limits per account. Shared by wichaa-archive-drip and defiant-wayback.

github-push.note: All pushes go out as NaNoBotCo. One at a time, small breathing room between. The lane sat unused from 2026-08-07, when the account was flagged and every publisher was rerouted to cloudflare-deploy; the flag was lifted 2026-09-08 and git-push-walk carries the lane again from 2026-09-16.

cloudflare-deploy.note: Wrangler deploys to Cloudflare Pages/Workers. One at a time: a wichaa refresh uploads ~30k files over ~25 minutes, and two overlapping deploys would fight over the staging dir in TMPDIR.

catalog.db.note: The manuscript crawler writes this while the wiki publish reads it. Exclusive lane.

dlntm.note: Manuscript source site. Be a polite guest.

passport-hd.note: External image store on /Volumes/Passport5TB. Must be mounted.

deadman-check.note: Hourly wellness check. No shared lanes; listed so the timetable shows the whole fleet.

lanna-crawler.note: Always-on (launchd KeepAlive). Its crawl steps run outside the tower, but its publish step (8/8) takes the cloudflare-deploy + catalog.db lanes via tower wrap (github-push until 2026-08-12).

lannawiki-publish.note: Nightly wiki build + deploy to Cloudflare Pages (wichaa + wichaa-m). Was github-push until 2026-08-12; the account suspension made that lane a dead end and the held lane stalled this job for five nights.

defiant-nightly.note: Defiant site nightly build + push. Declares NO lane here on purpose: most of its run is an OSM crawl (23 hubs at up to 180s each) that touches nothing shared, and holding github-push across all of it stalled every other push for half an hour on 2026-08-03. nightly.sh takes the lane around its `git push` line instead — the narrow hold is the right one.

hodie-ledger.note: Daily portal ledger task — runs as a Claude scheduled task in the cloud, not on this Mac. Listed for the timetable.

watchdog-switch.note: Daily watchdog — runs as a Claude scheduled task in the cloud. Listed for the timetable.

motdang-standing-walk.note: เดินเก็บเรื่อย ๆ — the standing walk. Publishes motdang.net perpetually: every 20 min it picks up whatever the maker bots finished and ships it, gated on a content fingerprint so an unchanged site is never rebuilt. Nobody asks whether to publish. Shares /tmp/motdang-walk.lock with the morning walk (which gathers the daily sources ahead of it) and takes cloudflare-deploy via `tower.py wrap --no-wait` at the deploy step. To pause it: mot-dang/cache/walk-rest.

search-core-sync.note: Regenerates the shared search tables (mine.py), pushes core + tables to every consumer (sync.py), and fails if the Python and JS runtimes disagree (parity.py). Deploys nothing. Exit 3 = refused a partial corpus read: mine.py will not build a smaller dictionary from a half-written build, having once quietly cut Mot Dang's segmentation vocabulary from 7,355 words to 4,109 by reading docs/ mid-rebuild. Safe to re-run any time; harmless if it collides with a build. Rollout queue for unwired sites: search-core/ROLLOUT.md.

portal-publish.note: Publishes nan.wichaa.net — the portal root plus the thairoots and skipdjt trees deploy.sh rsyncs into it. GATED ON CONTENT: portal_fingerprint.py hashes exactly what deploy.sh portal would upload, with generator timestamps dropped from the top level of any JSON, so an unchanged site is never re-uploaded and the log names whatever did change. Stands down silently when nothing moved. 04:40 sits after lannawiki-publish (03:00) and its ~25 min upload, and holds cloudflare-deploy so it can never overlap one. --gate-only to see what it would do; --force to deploy regardless (cache purge, rollback). The stamp is only written after a SUCCESSFUL deploy, so a failure retries rather than recording a publish that never reached the web. This was the fleet's one live site with no publisher: hodie-ledger wrote to the portal twice a day and it reached the web only when someone ran the lane by hand.

git-push-walk.note: Pushes any repo that already has a remote and is ahead of it. Never adds a remote, so the no-remote local-only set is unreachable from here. Greps every pending diff for case identifiers and refuses that repo on a hit.

index-nightly.note: The index: re-count every source, rebuild docs/, push. Declares no lane; nightly.sh takes github-push around its push line, like defiant-nightly.
